svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Status indicator (obc-status-indicator, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Alerts and status. Box 48x24 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_state (default 1, read): State: 0 inactive, 1 active, 2 running, 3 caution, 4 warning, 5 alarm; or a boolean (on/off) with _pn_onState _pn_onState (default -1, read): For a boolean tag: state shown when it is on (e.g. 2 running, 5 alarm; off = inactive). -1 = _pn_state is the state code
